name: Nigel Siwabessy
bio: Nigel Siwabessy is an Indonesian-American actor known for his roles in both American television and Indonesian cinema. He is half-Chinese and half-Indonesian, grew up in the United States, and attended California State University, Long Beach (CSULB).
